description: Start an A-to-Z Full Profile Upgrade session without requiring a prior user account. Stages 1-8 photos (via HTTPS URLs or base64 data URIs) or mints 6 signed upload slots + browser handoff URL, creates a $24.99 Full Profile Upgrade Stripe Checkout (30 credits: 15 Audit + 8 first Forge Photo + 7 left), and returns agent_session_token.

agent_platform.description: Caller platform name (e.g. chatgpt, gemini, grok, cursor, custom)

context.description: Optional dating context (app, city, goal, gender, age_bracket, residency, personal_facts)

email.description: Optional buyer email for Stripe checkout & report delivery

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key for checkout creation

image_base64.description: Base64 or data:image/* URIs of 1-8 dating profile photos

image_urls.description: HTTPS URLs of 1-8 dating profile photos

name: citadel_start_profile_upgrade
